legal.privacy.s1.h: Who we are and what we keep
legal.privacy.s1.p: Silent Whisker is a free, open-source project run by Bar Almog. Questions, requests and complaints go to <mail>{{email}}</mail>. You sign in with your Google account, through Amazon Cognito (the sign-in service of Amazon Web Services). From Google we receive your name, your email address and a link to your profile photo. Your name and email stay with the sign-in service and are not shown to other members; the photo is shown only if you choose. The full name shown in the app and your city you give us yourself. While you use the app we keep what you add: feeding and water logs, photos, comments, chat messages, spots and cat alerts, and the statistics they produce.
legal.privacy.s2.l1: To check that a log or an “empty” report was made at the spot. Only the distance, rounded to 10 metres, is kept, not the position.
legal.privacy.s2.l2: To place a cat alert, or a new spot added with “my location”. This position is kept exactly, and members see it on the map.
legal.privacy.s2.l3: To show nearby spots and to open the map in the right place. This position is not stored.
legal.privacy.s2.p: Your phone’s location is used for three things:
legal.privacy.s2.p2: A photo of a cat that is not at a spot keeps only its neighbourhood, never an exact point. You can turn location off at any time in your browser settings: the app still works, and a log without a good location is saved as not verified.
legal.privacy.s3.p: Photos and text (names, spot names, cat names, comments, chat) are checked automatically before anyone sees them, with the AI services of Amazon Web Services (Amazon Bedrock). Nothing is shown to others before it passes, and it stays hidden if the check cannot run. Members can report content; admins, who are volunteers, see what is reported and can hide it.
legal.privacy.s4.p: Every member sees your full name next to what you post. If you chose to, they also see your Google photo; otherwise an avatar with your initials. A spot that a member adds is shown to others only after an admin approves it, and only to members who are near it or when it needs help. City stations and cat alerts are shown to every member. Spots and cat alerts are shown on the map at their exact position, only to signed-in members. Someone who is not signed in sees no map. Other members never see your email address.
legal.privacy.s5.h: Where the data is stored and who else receives it
legal.privacy.s5.p: The data is stored with Amazon Web Services (AWS) in Stockholm, Sweden. The automatic checks of photos and text run on AWS in the European Union, and text may be processed in another AWS Region of the European Union. Sign-in goes through Google and Amazon Cognito. The map pictures come from OpenStreetMap, whose servers receive your IP address and the area you look at. When you search for a place on the map, your phone asks OpenStreetMap’s search service (Nominatim) directly, so it receives your IP address and the text you typed. The city in your profile and the address of a new spot are looked up by our server, which sends only that text. “Navigate” opens Google Maps only when you tap it. The public landing page may show ads from Google, and where the law requires it we ask for your consent first. A cat alert may be shared with organisations that can help the cat; your name is never shared. We do not sell your data.
legal.privacy.s6.p: The app keeps a few things in your browser’s local storage: the tokens that keep you signed in (for up to 30 days) and your language choice. The list of cat photos you have already seen is also kept on your phone, not on our server. Signing out removes the tokens, and you can clear everything at any time in your browser settings.
legal.privacy.s7.h: Your rights and deleting your account
legal.privacy.s7.p: You can see your details in Profile and change your name, city and photo choice there. You can ask to see all the data we hold about you, to correct it or to delete it by writing to <mail>{{email}}</mail>; we answer within 30 days. You can delete your account yourself in Profile: your name and sign-in are deleted, your photos, comments, messages and cat alerts are removed, and the spots, logs and likes you added stay without your name. If the account was blocked, we keep only its ID and the fact that it is blocked (no name, city or photo), and its sign-in stays switched off, so deleting the account does not lift the block. You can withdraw your consent to location at any time in your browser. This policy is written under the Israeli Protection of Privacy Law, as amended. If you believe your privacy was harmed, you may complain to the Privacy Protection Authority.
legal.privacy.s8.p: When the policy changes, the app asks you to accept the new version at your next visit.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.terms.s1.p: Silent Whisker is a free map and community for people who feed stray cats. Use it to help cats and the people who care for them. It is not an emergency service and does not replace a veterinarian or the authorities: a cat that needs urgent help needs someone who can come. Spots, logs and alerts are written by volunteers and may be wrong.
legal.terms.s2.p: You use Silent Whisker, go to any place and feed any cat at your own responsibility. The project is run by a volunteer and offered as it is, with no promise that a spot, a log or an alert is correct, that a cat will be fed or cared for, or that the service will always be available. To the extent the law allows, Silent Whisker and its operator are not liable for any damage or loss that comes from using the service.
legal.terms.s3.l1: Photos without a cat, in the feed and in alerts.
legal.terms.s3.l3: Locations that are wrong on purpose, or a feeding log for a feeding that did not happen.
legal.terms.s3.p: Photos, names and messages are checked automatically. You are responsible for what you post. Do not post:
legal.terms.s3.p2: By posting you let us show it to other members. You can remove your own photos, comments and messages at any time. Post only photos that you may share.
legal.terms.s4.p: Anyone who feeds cats must follow the rules of the place: the city bylaws, the building or yard rules, and a licence where one is required. The app does not decide what is allowed.
legal.terms.s5.h: Moderation and removal from the service
legal.terms.s5.p: Photos, names and messages are checked automatically, and members can report content. Admins, who are volunteers, can hide content, restrict chat or block members who break the terms. A blocked member can still read, but cannot add anything. Deleting the account does not lift a block. You can delete your account at any time in Profile. To ask about a restriction or a block, write to <mail>{{email}}</mail>.
legal.terms.s6.p: The source code of Silent Whisker is free and open under the MIT licence: you can read it, copy it and change it under that licence. The licence covers the code only, not other members’ photos, names or messages.
legal.terms.s7.p: When the terms change, the app asks you to accept the new version at your next visit. If you do not accept, you cannot keep using the app.
